title: feat(app-shell): app identity moves into the top bar
body:
Fixes #12201

Clause-②: yes

Executes the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-12 quoted in the card, items 1–6, and the card's Acceptance 1–6: the app's one identity asset moves into the top bar's app pill, the sidebar logo header goes, the phone drawer header names the app, the platform mark and the PREVIEW chip leave the bar's left edge inside an app, and the Studio entry gets a label. Out of this PR by dispatch: the card's `@objectstack/spec` rider on `branding.logo` (the spec seat files it on objectstack).

## What changed, by ruling item

1. **One asset.** `AppMark` (new, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppMark.tsx`, not exported from the package entry) draws `branding.logo` at the size the surface asks for: 22 px (`sm`) in the pill and in every dropdown row, 26 px (`md`) in the phone drawer header. It is decorative (`alt=""`), because every surface puts the app's name beside it.
2. **Pill and rows.** `AppSwitcher`'s trigger reads glyph, name, chevron, and each dropdown row draws its own app's glyph. Fallback: an app without `branding.logo` gets its `icon` through `getIcon` (the one lucide resolver, reused) on a tile. The tile takes the app's own `branding.primaryColor` when that is a hex, passed as CSS custom properties that static Tailwind utilities read, with a dark variant (the AGENTS.md section 2 carve-out). Otherwise it is the neutral muted tile. A logo URL that fails to load falls back to the same tile.
3. **Sidebar.** `UnifiedSidebar` no longer draws a `branding.logo` header. On a phone the drawer header shows the app's glyph (26 px) and name in place of the old Home row. Its trailing 「All apps」 button keeps `data-testid="mobile-sidebar-home"` and links `useHomePath()`, so it is still the way out of the app.
4. **Platform mark.** The `app` variant of `AppHeader` no longer draws it. The bar starts with the app pill, and no path separator precedes it. The `home`, `orgs` and `studio` variants keep the mark. Inside an app, the way back to Home is the switcher's new 「All apps」 row (the declared home, via `useHomePath()`).
5. **PREVIEW chip.** Inside an app it sits in the right-hand cluster, immediately before the search group. On platform surfaces it stays beside the mark.
6. **Studio entry.** The icon-only hammer becomes an outline button 「编辑应用」 / "Edit app" with a pencil. It is the first item of the right-hand utility group, before the bell. From `lg` (1024 px) up it shows the text; below that it is a square pencil button named by its `aria-label`, with a `title` tooltip. The gate (`canDesignInStudio = isWorkspaceAdmin && canAuthorMetadata`), the deep link (`studioDesignPath`) and `data-testid="app-design-in-studio-button"` are unchanged. The switcher dropdown ends with 「在 Studio 中编辑 APP」 / "Edit APP in Studio". `AppHeader` hands its own `studioDesignPath` to `AppSwitcher`, so the row and the button cannot disagree about who sees them or where they lead.

## Public surface (for the contract-tier read)

`@object-ui/app-shell`
- `AppSwitcher` (exported component) takes a new optional prop, `designInStudioPath?: string | null`. The change is additive. It also changes behaviour: the component now renders router `Link`s (「All apps」 and the Studio row), so it needs a Router context. The console always provides one.
- `AppHeader` (exported): no prop change. The `app` variant's markup changes: the platform mark is gone, the PREVIEW chip has moved right, and the Studio button is relabelled. Its `aria-label` and `title` were "Design in Studio" and are now "Edit app"; the test id is unchanged.
- `UnifiedSidebar` (exported): no prop change. The `branding.logo` `SidebarHeader` is removed. The phone drawer's Home row is replaced by the app header (`data-testid="mobile-sidebar-app"`), and `mobile-sidebar-home` stays on its 「All apps」 link.
- New modules `layout/AppMark.tsx` and `layout/appTileColors.ts` are internal: neither is added to `layout/index.ts` or to the package entry. No export is added or removed.

`@object-ui/i18n`: these keys are added to all ten packs. None is removed, and no export changes.
- `topbar.editApp`: zh 编辑应用, en Edit app
- `layout.appSwitcher.allApps`: zh 所有应用, en All apps
- `layout.appSwitcher.editAppInStudio`: zh 在 Studio 中编辑 {{app}}, en Edit {{app}} in Studio

`topbar.designInStudio` stays, because the AI Live Canvas still reads it.

Changeset: `.changeset/12201-app-identity-top-bar.md`, with `@object-ui/app-shell` minor and `@object-ui/i18n` minor.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured on `9646e2e`

1. The 「HotCRM ▾」 pill and its dropdown are `AppSwitcher.tsx` itself (its `DropdownMenuTrigger` button). Confirmed.
2. `AppHeader` learns the context from its `variant` prop (`isApp`). `ConsoleLayout` passes `variant="app"`, next to its own `setContext('app')`. Home and `/ai` pass `home`, the organizations pages `orgs`, and the Studio front door `studio`. `UnifiedSidebar` reads `useNavigationContext().context`. This PR uses `isApp`. Note: 「系统设置」 (the `setup` app) is mounted through `ConsoleLayout`, so it gets the app treatment: a pill and no mark.
3. The lucide resolver is `getIcon` (the components package's `getLazyIcon`), and it is reused. No resolver in app-shell turns a given app's `primaryColor` into a colour. Its one reader is `ConsoleLayout`, which hands the active app's branding to `@object-ui/layout`'s `AppShell`, and AppShell's hex helpers are module-private. The rows need each app's own colour, so the new `appTileColors` uses `@object-ui/core`'s exported `hexToHSL` and `contrastRatio`, and repeats AppShell's dark-mode lightness floor (at least 65 %). No second lucide resolver.
4. The gate and the deep link are as assumed. The dropdown row receives the button's own `studioDesignPath`, so it shares the gate and the link by construction.
5. There are ten packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/`, and all ten are updated.

## `AppHeader.tsx`: what moved, for the next card on this file (objectui#12198)

Blocks were edited in place; nothing was extracted or renamed.
- **Platform-logo `Link`:** wrapped in `!isApp` (it no longer carries `hidden sm:flex`).
- **Left-zone `PreviewBadge`:** gated on `!isApp`. A second, `isApp`-gated `PreviewBadge` is inserted right above the `Group 1: Search` block in the right cluster.
- **App-pill block:** its two leading `PathSep` spans are removed, and it passes `designInStudioPath={studioDesignPath}`.
- **Studio button:** moved from after `InboxPopover` to the first child of Group 2, and restyled.
- **Imports:** `Hammer` becomes `Pencil`, and `cn` is dropped.

The breadcrumb code is untouched and in its old place. The `extraSegments` computation still sits between `studioDesignPath` and the JSX, and its `routeType === 'page'` branch still pushes `t('console.breadcrumb.pages')`. The `extraSegments.map` render still sits between the app-pill block and the mobile page-label block.

## Verification, at head `c9ba7b82`

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. The command is `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test config's include glob `src/**/*.test.tsx` covers the new tests (not counted with `--listFiles`). Run after building app-shell's 28-package dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, 28/28).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/` plus `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256`, `appSidebarRemoved-5817` and `KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674`: `Test Files 64 passed (64)`, `Tests 462 passed (462)`. This includes the three new files, the rewritten `ConsoleLayout.appBrandingLogo-10827` (its reader assertion moved from the sidebar to the pill) and `AppHeader.designInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899`, unchanged and green against the new markup. This is a declared narrowing: the rest of app-shell is CI's.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 83 passed (83)`, `Tests 1321 passed / 13 skipped`. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n lint`: exit 0, with 0 errors in each (the warnings are the existing backlog; the new files carry none).
- Each of these gates exited 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (3 keys added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report; none of the new keys is listed), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:icon-record-names`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- **Reverse check, one-off:** each source file was put back to its `9646e2e` blob with the fix committed. The disk blob hash was checked against the BASE blob before each run, and HEAD was restored after it with the hash compared and `git diff HEAD` empty; a trap restores on any exit.
  - `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` at BASE: 5 failed / 5 passed. The failures were the four drawer-header cases and the sidebar-no-logo case.
  - `AppSwitcher.tsx` at BASE: 14 failed / 5 passed. Every pill and row case failed; the `appTileColors` units and the controls that do not depend on it passed.
  - `AppHeader.tsx` at BASE: 6 failed / 6 passed. The six app-context cases failed; the platform-surface controls, the member case and all three `10899` cases passed.

## NOT MEASURED

- **Browser screenshots** (zh-CN and en, at 1280, 768 and 375 px). No ObjectStack backend can run in this container: the `../objectstack` checkout has no `node_modules` and no built `dist`. Standing one up would take a full objectstack install and build on a 4-core box shared with parallel agents. The maintainer's staging screenshots come after the pin move.
- **`check:eager-locale-catalogues`:** PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it needs a full console build (`apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`). This diff adds keys inside the existing packs and no import of a locale module. CI's run is the reading.
- **`check:readme-exports`:** exit 1, but all 95 lines are "type entry not on disk", from packages outside app-shell's built closure. That is a prerequisite failure, not a finding. The README edit here is prose and no code block.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- **The org switcher still comes before the pill when it renders.** That is `WorkspaceSwitcher` for multi-org users, and `CurrentOrganizationIndicator` on single-org walled deployments. The ruling does not place it, so it keeps its place, and in that case the bar's left edge is the org name. Carrier: none.
- **The tile's dark derivation repeats AppShell's private lightness floor.** Consolidating it means exporting the helpers from `@object-ui/layout` or moving them into `@object-ui/core`, which is outside this claim. Carrier: none.
- **"Studio is never listed as an app" needed no filter.** As measured, a stock boot registers no `studio` app: per `@objectstack/studio`'s own header, it is not wired into the dev or serve plugin sets.
- **The 「Edit app」 tooltip is the native `title`**, as the hammer's was, not a Radix Tooltip.
- **The 7256 source-scan table has no row for the switcher's new 「All apps」 entry.** `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256`'s header says the old switcher Home row left with `AppSidebar`. The new entry is pinned behaviourally instead: `AppSwitcher.appIdentity-12201` checks that its href is the declared home. A scan row would be a one-line follow-up outside `layout/__tests__`.
- **File surface beyond the claim, stated:** `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md`, `content/docs/guide/console.md` and `packages/app-shell/README.md`. They describe exactly the UI this card moves, and AGENTS.md rule 2 requires them to follow the code. Also, `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md`'s layout diagram still places the app switcher in the sidebar. That was already stale before this PR (the switcher was in the top bar at BASE) and is left as is.
